# Blueroll
> Food safety management app for restaurants in the US, UK, and Europe

## Hub pages
- UK Restaurant Operations & Food Safety Library (all guides): https://blueroll.app/guides/uk

Blueroll is a mobile app that replaces paper HACCP records with digital checklists, AI-powered recipe import, allergen tracking, and one-tap compliance reports. Built for independent restaurants at $14.99/month with a 14-day free trial.

## Features
- Digital HACCP checklists (daily, weekly, monthly)
- AI recipe import (photo, text, PDF)
- Allergen matrix (9 US allergens + 14 EU allergens)
- Compliance PDF reports for health inspections
- Team management with check-in/check-out
- Temperature logging with alerts
- Document storage with expiry reminders
- Restaurant rating integration (US + UK)
